More room to understand.

01

Read comfortably

Enlarge the text, adjust contrast or go fullscreen. Choose a soft background and reading guides.

02

Listen at your pace

Play one paragraph, repeat it and correct its words before moving on. You decide when to continue.

03

Practice a language

Listen to a phrase and compare your pronunciation. Use English or Spanish independently of the menu language.

PRIVACY FROM THE START

Your conversations, on your device.

The app does not send your recordings or transcripts to a developer server. You choose what to save, delete and share.

Read our privacy policy →

Sessions are excluded from device backup. Export important content before uninstalling.

Different ways to follow the same conversation.

Reading tools to support people with hearing loss or low vision, plus language practice for children with adult guidance. Feature availability depends on your device and installed models.

Explore accessibility options →

Captions and translations may contain errors. Check important information. VoiceToRead does not replace professional interpretation or the accessibility services you need.
